Name: Lumisteria Plants In Watering Cans for Json Assets
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
[img]data:image/png;base64,[/img] This mod adds new big craftables with Json Assets : flowers and plants in decorative watering cans. [img]data:image/png;base64,[/img]

There are 16 different flowers and plants you can craft : all the recipes will ask for copper, and one ingredient depending of the plant. Buy the recipe at Clint's shop.
